title: skills/objectstack-api: teach the /meta/:type list door's ?names= filter and its closed query set (follow-up of #29236)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytQjG9X1CrCgytUM5

Filing gate: ② a ruling's owed follow-up. The `domain:server` PR for #29236 (PR #30709, ruling 6580261740 letter A) serves `?names=a,b,c` on every `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` list and closes the list door's query set, so a misspelt filter answers `400` instead of the full list. Its PR body carries `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · a customer agent reading the skill learns the list read has no narrowing and sends one request per name.

## What the skill says today

`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, section "Metadata API (`/meta`)": lists `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` and the read-side params `?preview=draft`, `?package=`, `?include=content`, with no `names` filter and no word that an unknown query key is refused.

## Wanted (after PR #30709 merges)

- One short addition: `?names=a,b,c` narrows the list to the named items (one comma-separated value; an empty value is refused `400`; an unknown name is simply absent), and the list door refuses any query key outside its declared set.
- Keep it inside the package's line budget; the evals that exercise the metadata read pick it up.
- `skills/**` is a governed path (Tier H): the PR needs governed approval.

Serial: after PR #30709 merges.

Dedupe: `skills objectstack-api meta names` → none open. **New.**

Links back: #29236, PR #30709, ruling 6580261740.
